title: In Apache James server prior version 3.9.1 relying on the SieveFileRepository incorect validation of file paths can…
description: Apache James server versions prior to 3.9.1 have a vulnerability in the SieveFileRepository component due to incorrect validation of file paths. This flaw allows authenticated attackers to perform path traversal, enabling them to set arbitrary SIEVE scripts for other users. Exploitation can lead to denial of service or interception of mail traffic. Upgrading to version 3.9.1 addresses this issue.
